items.title: Commission approves €9 billion Spanish capacity mechanism for security of electricity supply
items.description: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 May 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €9 billion capacity mechanism for electricity supply for Spain. This aid measure aims to ensure that there is sufficient capacity to produce, store or flexibly consume electricity and that electricity production meets the expected demand.

items.title: EU fines Temu €200M over unsafe toys, non-compliant products
items.description: EU regulators said Temu failed to identify and assess the systemic risks of illegal products' on its platform and the harm they posed to consumers.

items.title: France moves to symbolically repeal slavery legislation
items.description: Members of the lower house of the French parliament unanimously voted to abolish a series of royal edicts known as the "Code noir" or Black Code. The bill stops short of some lawmakers' demands like possible reparations.
